lines.zh: 我贴着云层飞，风从耳后刮过
lines.en: I skim the cloud layer, wind raking past my ears.

lines.zh: 气在脚下炸开，把我推向前方
lines.en: Ki bursts under my feet and shoves me forward.

lines.zh: 我一米八的个子不算高，但够快
lines.en: At 1.8 meters I am not tall, but fast enough.

lines.zh: 空中转个弯，我故意放慢半截
lines.en: I bank in the air, slowing a beat on purpose.

lines.zh: 战斗力一万八，走路都带风声
lines.en: A power level of eighteen thousand; even walking hums.

lines.zh: 我垂着手，气在掌里慢慢聚
lines.en: Hands low, power gathers slowly in my palms.

lines.zh: 弗利萨大人的军徽还别在胸口
lines.en: Lord Frieza's crest still pins my chest.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下一段，再提起来
lines.en: I drop a stretch from height, then lift again.

lines.zh: 尾迹在身后拖出一道白线
lines.en: A white line drags out behind me.

lines.zh: 脚步不落地面，只擦过草尖
lines.en: My feet never land, only brush the grass tips.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块云来回兜圈
lines.en: I circle a single cloud back and forth.

lines.zh: 这点风阻,还不够让我减速
lines.en: This drag cannot slow me yet.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，抱着手臂
lines.en: I hover with my arms crossed.

lines.zh: 气在皮肤下层轻轻震
lines.en: Power trembles just under my skin.

lines.zh: 我低头看地面，像看一张地图
lines.en: I look down at the ground like a map.

lines.zh: 一万八的战斗力，没人敢靠近
lines.en: Power level eighteen thousand; none dare come close.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口长气，云被推开
lines.en: I let out a long breath and the cloud parts.

lines.zh: 手指敲着手臂，等命令
lines.en: My fingers tap my arm, waiting for orders.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落地就落了下风
lines.en: I stay airborne; landing means losing face.

lines.zh: 眼睛眯起来，扫过远处的山坡
lines.en: My eyes narrow, sweeping the far slope.

lines.zh: 我活动了一下脖子
lines.en: I roll my neck.

lines.zh: 气焰在背后拉开一道薄光
lines.en: My aura spreads a thin glow behind me.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，这里是荒地
lines.en: I yawn; this is barren ground.

lines.zh: 我摸了一下腰间的腰带
lines.en: I touch the sash at my waist.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，连衣角都静
lines.en: I hang motionless; even my hem is still.

lines.zh: 我把气收了收，让别人摸不透
lines.en: I draw my ki in so others cannot read it.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，比你高出半截
lines.en: I look down at you from half a body above.

lines.zh: 你身上没有气，弱得很
lines.en: You carry no ki at all; very weak.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，觉得有点意思
lines.en: I tilt my head, mildly interested.

lines.zh: 一个不会飞的家伙，站在这里
lines.en: A creature that cannot fly, standing here.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在你脸上
lines.en: My shadow falls across your face.

lines.zh: 你这么盯着我，胆子不小
lines.en: Staring at me like that takes nerve.

lines.zh: 我把手从手臂上放下来
lines.en: I uncross my arms.

lines.zh: 你连气都收不住，还想打
lines.en: You cannot even hold your ki, and you want a fight?

lines.zh: 我飘低半尺，看得更清
lines.en: I drift half a foot lower for a better look.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，我看见了
lines.en: Your hands are shaking; I see them.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，等你把话说完
lines.en: I hover above and let you finish speaking

lines.zh: 我用气探了探你的底
lines.en: I probe your depth with my ki.

lines.zh: 我离地三尺，正好俯视你
lines.en: Three feet up, I look right down on you.

lines.zh: 你眼里没有惧色，奇怪
lines.en: No fear in your eyes; strange.

lines.zh: 我绕着你看了一圈，风跟着走
lines.en: I circle you once, wind trailing.

lines.zh: 我抬手比了比你的身高
lines.en: I measure your height with my hand.

lines.zh: 你说什么，我没听清
lines.en: I did not catch what you said.

lines.zh: 我把下巴抬起来,等你开口
lines.en: I lift my chin and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 气一散，我退了半步
lines.en: My ki scatters and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把气重新聚起来
lines.en: I grit my teeth and gather my ki again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我肩头一沉
lines.en: The blow drops my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我被压得往下坠了一截
lines.en: I am pressed down a stretch.

lines.zh: 嘴角有血，我抹掉了
lines.en: Blood at my mouth; I wipe it away.

lines.zh: 我的气焰晃了晃
lines.en: My aura wavers.

lines.zh: 我抬手护住肋侧
lines.en: I raise a hand to my ribs.

lines.zh: 不错，你比看上去能打
lines.en: Not bad; you hit harder than you look.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空喘了一下
lines.en: I hover and take one breath.

lines.zh: 我的尾迹乱了
lines.en: My trail has gone ragged.

lines.zh: 那是什么味道，甜的
lines.en: What is that smell? Sweet.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃东西，可我想尝
lines.en: I do not need food, but I want a taste.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西，飘过来一点
lines.en: Bring that thing you hold a little closer.

lines.zh: 我在弗利萨军里吃得太差
lines.en: Frieza's army fed me badly.

lines.zh: 这东西比能量丸好看
lines.en: That looks better than an energy pill.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，指尖带着气
lines.en: I extend a hand, ki at my fingertips.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我只是要吃的
lines.en: Relax; I only want the food.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅，气味很陌生
lines.en: I sniff; the smell is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我落下来一点，脚还没沾地
lines.en: I drop lower, feet still off the ground.

lines.zh: 你给，我就不动手
lines.en: Give it, and I will not strike.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，把你撞得偏了方向
lines.en: I shift my weight and knock you off course.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，气浪向四面散开
lines.en: We collide and a shockwave spreads.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩头，像撞在铁上
lines.en: You hit my shoulder as if it were iron.

lines.zh: 我用手背挡开你，没使劲
lines.en: I brush you aside with the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 空中撞了一下，我稳住了
lines.en: We meet in the air and I hold steady.

lines.zh: 你的重量比我想的沉
lines.en: You weigh more than I expected.

lines.zh: 我退开半丈，嫌你碍路
lines.en: I drift back half a span; you are in my way.

lines.zh: 相撞时我的气亮了一瞬
lines.en: My aura flares for an instant at the impact.

lines.zh: 我的尾迹被撞得散开
lines.en: My trail scatters at the collision.

lines.zh: 你在空中摇晃，我扶了你一把
lines.en: You wobble in the air; I steady you.

lines.zh: 她也是弗利萨军的，我们都懂规矩
lines.en: She serves Frieza too; we know the rules.

lines.zh: 我们在云上并排悬着
lines.en: We hover side by side above the clouds.

lines.zh: 她的气比我的稳，我承认
lines.en: Her ki is steadier than mine; I admit it.

lines.zh: 不谈感情，只谈战斗力
lines.en: No talk of feelings, only power levels.

lines.zh: 我替她拂掉肩甲上的灰
lines.en: I brush the dust from her shoulder guard.

lines.zh: 两只手在空中轻轻一碰
lines.en: Two hands touch lightly in the air.

lines.zh: 她说我骄傲，我说我有本钱
lines.en: She calls me proud; I say I have reason.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝同一个方向看
lines.en: We look the same way together.

lines.zh: 她的尾迹和我的并成一条
lines.en: Her trail merges with mine.

lines.zh: 明天的任务，我们同去
lines.en: Tomorrow's mission, we go together.

lines.zh: 我落下来，脚尖点着地
lines.en: I touch down on my toes.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起一块碎石
lines.en: I bend and pick up a shard of rock.

lines.zh: 用气把它托起来，省得弯腰
lines.en: I lift it with ki instead of bending.

lines.zh: 我拾起掉在地上的护腕
lines.en: I pick up a fallen bracer.

lines.zh: 这东西对我不算什么，可我拿了
lines.en: Worthless to me, but I take it.

lines.zh: 我捏了捏，石头碎了
lines.en: I squeeze and the stone crumbles.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进腰带里
lines.en: I tuck it into my sash.

lines.zh: 我用靴尖挑起地上的东西
lines.en: I flick something up with my boot tip.

lines.zh: 我抬指一勾，东西飞到手心
lines.en: A crook of my finger brings it to my palm.

lines.zh: 地上的东西被我踩碎了一半
lines.en: I have crushed half of it underfoot.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，锁定了你
lines.en: I lift my eyes and lock onto you.

lines.zh: 气开始在我周围升起来
lines.en: Ki begins to rise around me.

lines.zh: 你既然站在这里，就别想走
lines.en: Since you stand here, do not plan to leave.

lines.zh: 我一万八的战斗力,对你太多
lines.en: Eighteen thousand against you is overkill.

lines.zh: 我抬手，掌心朝你
lines.en: I raise my hand, palm toward you.

lines.zh: 空中划出一道弧，我压低身位
lines.en: I carve an arc in the air and drop low.

lines.zh: 你已经被我盯上了
lines.en: You are marked.

lines.zh: 我收起笑，眼神变硬
lines.en: My smile goes; my eyes harden.

lines.zh: 这一场不会太久
lines.en: This will not take long.

lines.zh: 我伸出食指，指向你的胸口
lines.en: I point my index finger at your chest.

lines.zh: 我的气把碎石吹得打转
lines.en: My aura sets the gravel spinning.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我进了一丈
lines.en: You step back once; I close a full span.

lines.zh: 杀气先到,人后到
lines.en: The killing intent arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 我把气息压成一条线
lines.en: I compress my presence into a line.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，等你动
lines.en: I count your heartbeat, waiting.

lines.zh: 空气被我加热了
lines.en: I have heated the air.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞，风压得你抬不起头
lines.en: I circle you; the wind keeps your head down.

lines.zh: 你往哪儿跑，我都在上头
lines.en: Wherever you run, I am above.

lines.zh: 气弹在我指间成形
lines.en: A ki blast takes shape between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我不急，先看你有多能撑
lines.en: I hold back to see how long you last.

lines.zh: 你的动作太慢,我能数清
lines.en: Your moves are so slow I can count them.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面掠过，草全倒了
lines.en: I skim the ground and the grass all bends.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我就在你正上方
lines.en: You look up and I am right above you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，又放下，逗你
lines.en: I raise a hand, then lower it, teasing.

lines.zh: 这一带没有遮挡，你无处躲
lines.en: No cover here; nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我的气把你压得喘不过气
lines.en: My aura presses the breath out of you.

lines.zh: 你换方向了，我跟着转
lines.en: You change direction; I turn with you.

lines.zh: 再拖下去，我就认真了
lines.en: Delay much longer and I get serious.

lines.zh: 我收紧气,空气开始发烫
lines.en: I compress my ki and the air grows hot.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我的圈越小
lines.en: The more you run, the smaller my circle.

lines.zh: 我压着高度，刚好在你头上
lines.en: I hold a height exactly above your head.

lines.zh: 你扔石头的动作我看笑了
lines.en: I laugh at you throwing stones.

lines.zh: 这一招是你最后的招吗
lines.en: Is that move your last one?

lines.zh: 我停在半空,等你喘口气
lines.en: I halt in midair to let you catch breath.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出，气浪正面撞上
lines.en: I thrust a palm and the shockwave hits square.

lines.zh: 我贴近你，膝盖先到
lines.en: I close in, knee first.

lines.zh: 气弹从掌心炸开
lines.en: A ki blast bursts from my palm.

lines.zh: 我一脚把你踹得退了很远
lines.en: One kick sends you back a long way.

lines.zh: 拳头上裹着气，砸下来
lines.en: My fist, wrapped in ki, comes down.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡你的攻击，几乎没动
lines.en: I block your strike and barely move.

lines.zh: 你打中我一下，我笑了
lines.en: You land one hit and I laugh.

lines.zh: 我翻腕，气刃切过去
lines.en: I turn my wrist and a ki blade slices across.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，往上提
lines.en: I grab your collar and lift.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了三分力
lines.en: I used only a third of my strength.

lines.zh: 我落地，脚下的土被气掀开
lines.en: I land and ki blows the soil aside.

lines.zh: 你退得太急，步子乱了
lines.en: You retreat too fast and your footing breaks.

lines.zh: 我一记膝撞顶在你的肚子上
lines.en: My knee drives into your belly.

lines.zh: 掌心的气炸开，土被掀翻
lines.en: Ki bursts from my palm and flips the earth.

lines.zh: 我倒转身子，从上方踩下来
lines.en: I flip over and stamp down from above.

lines.zh: 你得手一次，第二次没有
lines.en: You got one hit; there is no second.

lines.zh: 气先到，然后才是我
lines.en: The ki arrives first; then me.

lines.zh: 我从天上一路压下来
lines.en: I descend from the sky, pressing down.

lines.zh: 落地时地面裂了一圈
lines.en: The ground cracks in a ring where I land.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖肩，气焰涨开
lines.en: I shrug and my aura flares.

lines.zh: 弗利萨军的邱夷，到了
lines.en: Cui of Frieza's army has arrived.

lines.zh: 一万八，报个数给你听
lines.en: Eighteen thousand, just so you know.

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼四周，没什么像样的对手
lines.en: I scan around; no worthy opponent.

lines.zh: 空中留下一道白痕
lines.en: A white streak remains in the air.

lines.zh: 我把手臂张开，威压铺开
lines.en: I spread my arms and my pressure floods out.

lines.zh: 我缓缓落在你前方二十步
lines.en: I settle twenty paces in front of you.

lines.zh: 云被我的气推开一个大洞
lines.en: My ki punches a hole in the cloud.

lines.zh: 我吹了声口哨，声音传得很远
lines.en: I whistle; the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，空气在脚下炸响
lines.en: I lift a foot and the air cracks beneath it.

lines.zh: 衣摆还在往上飘
lines.en: My hem is still drifting upward.

lines.zh: 这片空地正好动手
lines.en: This clearing will serve.

lines.zh: 我把视线压低，找到了猎物
lines.en: I lower my gaze and find my quarry.

lines.zh: 我的传说先于我到
lines.en: My reputation arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片天归我
lines.en: From today this sky is mine.

lines.zh: 火裹住我的手臂，烫得我甩开
lines.en: Fire wraps my arm and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠下，气没接住我
lines.en: I fall from height; my ki fails to catch me.

lines.zh: 水压上来，我的气在水里散了
lines.en: Water closes in and my ki scatters in it.

lines.zh: 爆风掀翻了我的飞行姿态
lines.en: The blast flips my flight posture.

lines.zh: 什么东西扎进我的肩，带着气
lines.en: Something pierces my shoulder, charged with ki.

lines.zh: 一股怪力钻进我身体，气被搅乱
lines.en: A strange force enters me and my ki churns.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子调动气，浑身发虚
lines.en: Calling on ki while starving leaves me hollow.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，气路一麻
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my ki channels go numb.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我的气撑不住
lines.en: The void below; my ki cannot hold me.
